Device Fabrication : The p-i-n planar structured PSCs were fabricated with the configuration ITO/2PACz/RPP/with or without passivation/PCBM/PEI/Ag. The 2PACz HTL was deposited on the UV-ozonetreated ITO substrates by spin-coating at 3000 rpm for 30 s with annealing at 60 ° C for 3 min. Then, the substrates were transferred into a N 2 -filled glove box. The RPP layers were fabricated by spin-casting at 5000 rpm for 20 s on the preheated substrates (100 ° C over 15 min), and then the films were transferred into a low vacuum chamber ( -1 bar) for suppressed nucleation for at least 8 min. [34] After low-vacuum processing, the RPP films were thermally annealed at 100 ° C for 10 min.

unresolved_notes: The source does not establish that the optimized Table 1 devices, light-intensity-analysis devices, transient-photocurrent devices, or forward/reverse-sweep device were the same physical specimens; they are therefore kept as separate individual-device records.

The forward and reverse J-V curves are identified, but no direction-specific numeric outcome is supplied. The reported comparison-level outcome, "negligible hysteresis," is retained without inventing separate forward- and reverse-scan values.
Figure S12 establishes control and PBN-treated PV-parameter distributions, but no sample size or numeric distribution summary is supplied; no values were digitized from the histograms.

The thermal- and humidity-stability evidence identifies both control and PBN-treated traces, but the supplied text gives checkpoint retention values only for the PBN-treated devices. Control thermal and humidity tests were not instantiated because no independently usable control outcome was supplied and graph traces were not digitized.

The optimized PBN concentration is rendered as "5.0 mm" in the main-text extraction, whereas the Supporting Information caption renders the low concentration as "5.0mM". The source renderings were not silently reconciled. The optimized-device property retains "5.0 mm"; the family-wide PBN processing step retains the broader source wording "various molar ratios in IPA" because concentration was varied across the processing arm.

The PBN concentration optimization arm included PSCs treated with different molar ratios, but no individual device-level results or complete concentration-to-device identities are supplied. It was not converted into additional device families or individual-device records.

The fresh-versus-500 h photoaged PSCs were used for TOF-SIMS characterization. Their supplied outcomes concern ion distributions rather than photovoltaic performance retention, so they were excluded as stability tests.

Hole-only and electron-only stacks, RPP films, TRPL and transient-absorption specimens, iodide solutions, and other partial or material-characterization specimens were excluded because they are not complete photovoltaic devices measured for photovoltaic performance.
